rubric.role_summary: Electrical engineer owning avionics, power distribution, communications, and electrical integration for high-power electric VTOL aircraft, from design through assembly and ground and flight testing.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Electrical engineer owning avionics, power distribution, communications, and electrical integration for high-power electric VTOL aircraft, from design through assembly and ground and flight testing.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics, or a related field.
- Experience designing and integrating electrical or avionics systems.
- Understanding of power electronics or embedded systems.
- Ability to create and review schematics, wiring diagrams, pinout tables, and engineering drawings.
- Experience using oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and other laboratory equipment.
- Experience troubleshooting complex electrical systems at the component and system levels.
- Hands-on hardware integration experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with electric aircraft, drones, robotics, automotive systems, spacecraft, or other safety-critical hardware.
- Experience with high-voltage and high-current lithium battery systems.
- Experience integrating motors, ESCs, battery-management systems, contactors, and power-distribution units.
- Experience with CAN, DroneCAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, RS-232, or RS-485.
- Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, CubePilot, or similar autopilot ecosystems.
- Experience designing PCBs in Altium, KiCad, OrCAD, or a similar platform.
- Familiarity with EMI/EMC testing and aerospace grounding and shielding practices.
- Familiarity with environmental qualification, electrical derating, FMEA, and fault-tolerant design.
- Understanding of aviation development standards such as DO-160, DO-254, or SAE aerospace practices.
- Experience taking an electrical system from prototype through low-rate production.
- Understanding of power electronics, embedded systems, digital communications, and electrical protection.
- Ability to work directly with hardware and support hands-on aircraft integration.
- Technical documentation and configuration-management skills.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Oregon. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
